source_domain_basis: Intersection of the model-selected gas phase domains, 298.15..1200 K. Raw CO/CO2 source polynomials extend to 2200 K, but this stage retains the narrower admitted model domain; no phase domain is widened.
scope: Independent source-defined zero-storage surface. Two existing virtual exchange laws connect bath-surface and surface-bulk; blackbody heat is absorbed at the surface. Species stationarity eliminates four chemical potentials analytically at fixed surface T; one energy root remains. Qualify this constitutive relation before any dynamic coupling; do not replace direct-terminal baseline or infer measured brick surface properties.
